name: Master-Com
description: The Czerka Corporation Master Control System, also referred to as Master-Com, was a supercomputer that controlled and monitored the systems of the Mid Rim casino space station known as the Wheel. Installed during the Wheel's construction in 84 BBY, Master-Com took its most recognizable form during the reign of administrator Simon Greyshade, who ordered the construction of dozens of droid bodies for Master-Com's artificial consciousness to inhabit. Afterward, Master-Com became the former Senator's right-hand machine, known for its genial manner and efficient operation of the station's systems.
